criteria.requirement: Implement DispatchConfigFileParser(parsers, *, fallback=None, output_format=None) with an application-owned extension registry of ConfigFileParser instances/classes. Normalize suffix case, reject duplicate normalized extensions and invalid parser registrations. Dispatch once from stream.name without reading/rewinding/sniffing/importing; unknown or unnamed sources require explicit fallback. Propagate actual parse and optional dependency errors. Serialization requires an explicitly registered output_format and delegates to that parser. Preserve existing CompositeConfigParser and support nonseek streams.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
